content:
maria: Thinking about adding a lightweight 'audit_shim' on routing policy changes so exports can show the minimal context (who, why, delta) without pulling full snapshot. keeps NDJSON small.

derek: curious — is this for realtime streaming exports or only for batch downloads?

maria: both. idea is: small shim record on change events that references the full blob if needed. exports can include shim-only for fast compliance views.

sasha: UX: console should show shim summary inline, then a 'download full proof' CTA. avoids overfetch for common cases.

anita: telemetry note: emit export.kind=(shim|full), export.size_bytes, export.duration_ms, export.sampling_mode. we need these for cost ops dashboards.

maria: +1 telemetry. also want a 'signed_bundle_manifest' field for download links and their TTLs.

ops-bot: export-job queued for tenant=acme-corp export_id=exp-5201 status=queued

jen: security question — if we put a link to full blob, it has to be audited and short TTL, or we need presigned with IP restriction. can't leak PII.

paul: agreed. propose two tiers: shim-only public in console for operators, full-bundle requires export ACL & presigned link.

kevin: quota concern: if many customers request full-bundles on the same change window we'll blow egress and generation CPU. need per-tenant export quotas + backpressure.

maria: proposal: new API param export.scope = (shim|compact|full). default=compact (shim + deltas). compact counts against lightweight export quota. full consumes heavy export quota.

derek: what about canary rollouts? we should be able to enable shim-only mode for a subset of tenants to gauge telemetry before wide rollout.

sasha: console flow: toggle in rollout UI labelled 'audit shim rollout' with % rollout, and an opt-in button on tenant page. show telemetry sparklines before/after.

anita: add telemetry events: rollout.start, rollout.step(percent, tenants), rollout.error, export.shim_hit_rate. also tag events with route_policy_id.

maria: here's a sample shim NDJSON line we discussed, short and safe:

```
{"ts":5201234567, "actor":"maria", "policy_id":"rp-42", "delta":"allow from 10.0.0.0/8", "reason":"prod rollback after perf issue", "full_blob_ref":"s3://redwood-proof/exp-5201/rp-42.json.gz"}
```

jen: full_blob_ref must be optional and redacted in shim export if tenant opted out. also ensure we don't include IPs in plain text unless tenant config allows.

paul: operationally, we can fold the shim writer into the routing service — emit shim to changefeed and to audit-log service for indexing. then export workers fanout NDJSON.

kevin: fanout strategy: make shim exports incremental (append-only) and full exports as snapshot-on-demand. incremental reduces reprocessing.

derek: is there a policy to cap shim retention? compliance might want 1y, engineering wants 30d for fast dashboards. we need retention tiering in export API.

maria: retention param on export manifest: retention_days=(30|90|365). default 90. longer retention requires enterprise plan and log-archival.

ops-bot: export-job started export_id=exp-5201 status=running percent=3

anita: one more instrumentation ask: emit event export.delivery_mode=(console|ndjson|webhook) and export.consumers_count. helps forecast costs for webhook consumers.

sasha: for console UX, show a diff-preview inline using the shim delta, with an expand to full proof. make sure we surface 'confidence' when the shim omits context ("likely reason only").

maria: final open questions: 1) do we keep shim shape minimal JSON or key-value envelope? 2) do we auto-sample full blobs for telemetry? 3) exact quota units for compact vs full.

jen: my votes: minimal shape, yes auto-sample 0.5% of full blobs (configurable), and compact=1 export unit, full=10 units.

paul: I'll prototype writer in routing-service branch 'audit-shim' and add an opt-in flag. canary to 2 tenants first.

kevin: I'll sketch quota throttle: token-bucket per-tenant for full exports + global rate limiter for heavy bundles.

derek: i'll draft console mocks for the shim diff and rollout toggles. will post tomorrow.

maria: thanks all. plan: paul prototype, anita telemetry hooks, kevin quotas, sasha console mocks. we'll sync in week's infra sync.

ops-bot: export-job update export_id=exp-5201 status=completed percent=100 artifacts=[shim.ndjson] size_bytes=12456 duration_ms=7800

maria: ran quick local on prototype, shim.ndjson looks good. will share sample in the PR.
